sourceCards.flavorMatchRationale: Excellent match: A land that enters slowly but immediately scries makes the waiting harbor itself the place where the future is read.

sourceCards.story: Book XXII / after the suitors are killed, the same hall is washed and purified before the household can become a home again.
sourceCards.credit: Art: Theodoor van Thulden, after Francesco Primaticcio · Rijksmuseum · CC0
sourceCards.storyTarget: Book XXII / cleansing and purification of the great hall after the reckoning.
sourceCards.flavorStoryElement: The great hall has an after-state: the bloodshed is followed by cleaning, fumigation, and the difficult restoration of household order.
sourceCards.flavorMatchRationale: The common Great Hall remains the place of appetite and mounting violence; this rare scry land now represents the same room after the reckoning, avoiding a second generic battle-hall identity.

Sanctuary of Hades represented by Island of the Dead. Use the 1880 Met version, not the Berlin third version already catalogued as ART-292. Symbolic funerary landscape, not a literal Greek cult site. Keep the arriving boat, cypresses and tomb entrances; check dark-image legibility at card size.
